metadata.title: Pastoral Piano Horizon
useCases: Serene landscape photography with human elements

retrievalProfile.description: A wide-angle landscape featuring a grand piano atop a grassy hill against a vast sky, anchored by wide-tracked red serif display text at the top.
triggerTerms: wide landscape with top-aligned red serif text

recipe.visualDefinition: A serene, wide-angle outdoor scene depicting a grand piano positioned on the crest of a grassy, sloping hill. The subject is placed to the left, silhouetted against a pale blue sky that transitions to a warm, hazy horizon. The composition is balanced by a large expanse of negative space in the sky, which hosts a single line of widely spaced, vibrant red serif typography across the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the left third of the frame
High horizon line created by the sloping hill
Vibrant red text contrasting with the cool blue and green palette
Vast negative space in the upper right sky area
coreInvariants: Wide-tracked serif typography at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The piano and figure are medium-scale, located in the lower-left quadrant on a diagonal hill crest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The grand piano acts as the primary visual weight, while the red text anchors the top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red text, follows the sky down to the piano, and then moves along the slope of the hill to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the sky occupies approximately 60% of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale blue sky and muted green grass provide a natural, cool base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the piano provides structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red is used for the typography and a small garment detail to draw focus.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the landscape allows the high-saturation red text to pop.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely wide tracking between all characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact through spacing.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the top margin

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif structure with sharp terminals.
High contrast and elegant curves suitable for the pastoral theme.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of a grand piano on a grassy hill under a clear blue sky at dawn. The hill slopes downward from left to right. A figure in dark clothing sits at the piano. The upper half of the image is mostly empty sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase serif text in a vibrant red color across the top margin. Apply extremely wide tracking so the text spans nearly the full width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the text positioned at the very top?
Is the tracking wide enough to create a rhythmic horizontal line?
Is the piano placed on the left side of the hill?
Is the color of the text a bright, saturated red?

adjustableVariables: Amount of negative space in the sky
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the person
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible and correctly tracked
Horizon line is not centered vertically
Color palette remains naturalistic except for the text
Composition feels balanced despite the asymmetrical subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Wide landscape + Asymmetrical subject + Top-aligned wide-tracked serif text = Pastoral Elegance
